verses.original: שָׁמוֹר֙ אֶת־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָאָבִ֔יב וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פֶּ֔סַח לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֞י בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֗יב יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ הוֹצִ֨יאֲךָ֜ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mō·wr ’eṯ- ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā pe·saḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā kî bə·ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā hō·w·ṣî·’ă·ḵā mim·miṣ·ra·yim lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: Observe - the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night

verses.original: וְזָבַ֥חְתָּ לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ פֶּ֛סַח וּבָקָ֑ר צֹ֣אן בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֔ה יִבְחַ֣ר לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḇaḥ·tā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā pe·saḥ ū·ḇā·qār ṣōn bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- Yah·weh yiḇ·ḥar lə·šak·kên šə·mōw šām
verses.literal: You are to offer to the LORD your God the Passover sacrifice from the herd or flock in the place - the LORD will choose as a dwelling for His Name . . .

verses.original: לֹא־ תֹאכַ֤ל חָמֵ֔ץ עָלָיו֙ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים תֹּֽאכַל־ עָלָ֥יו מַצּ֖וֹת לֶ֣חֶם עֹ֑נִי כִּ֣י יָצָ֙אתָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְחִפָּז֗וֹן לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכֹּר֔ אֶת־ י֤וֹם כֹּ֖ל חַיֶּֽיךָ׃ יְמֵ֥י צֵֽאתְךָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯō·ḵal ḥā·mêṣ ‘ā·lāw šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tō·ḵal- ‘ā·lāw maṣ·ṣō·wṯ le·ḥem ‘ō·nî kî yā·ṣā·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ḇə·ḥip·pā·zō·wn lə·ma·‘an tiz·kōr ’eṯ- yō·wm kōl ḥay·ye·ḵā yə·mê ṣê·ṯə·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim
verses.literal: You must not eat leavened bread with it for seven days you are to eat with it unleavened bread the bread of affliction because you left the land of Egypt in haste so that you may remember - - for the rest of your life the day you left the land of Egypt

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ שְׂאֹ֛ר יֵרָאֶ֨ה לְךָ֥ בְּכָל־ גְּבֻלְךָ֖ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְלֹא־ מִן־ הַבָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּזְבַּ֥ח בָּעֶ֛רֶב הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בַּיּ֥וֹם יָלִ֣ין לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- śə·’ōr yê·rā·’eh lə·ḵā bə·ḵāl gə·ḇul·ḵā šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·lō- min- hab·bā·śār ’ă·šer tiz·baḥ bā·‘e·reḇ hā·ri·šō·wn bay·yō·wm yā·lîn lab·bō·qer
verses.literal: No leaven is to be found in all your land for seven days and none of the meat - you sacrifice in the evening of the first day shall remain until morning

verses.original: לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לִזְבֹּ֣חַ אֶת־ הַפָּ֑סַח בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯū·ḵal liz·bō·aḥ ’eṯ- hap·pā·saḥ bə·’a·ḥaḏ šə·‘ā·re·ḵā ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: You are not . . . to sacrifice - the Passover animal in any of the towns that the LORD your God is giving you

verses.original: כִּ֠י אִֽם־ תִּזְבַּ֥ח אֶת־ הַפֶּ֖סַח אֶל־ הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ יִבְחַ֨ר לְשַׁכֵּ֣ן שְׁמ֔וֹ שָׁ֛ם בָּעָ֑רֶב הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ כְּב֣וֹא מוֹעֵ֖ד צֵֽאתְךָ֥ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- tiz·baḥ ’eṯ- hap·pe·saḥ ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yiḇ·ḥar lə·šak·kên šə·mōw šām bā·‘ā·reḇ haš·še·meš kə·ḇō·w mō·w·‘êḏ ṣê·ṯə·ḵā mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: You must only . . . offer - the Passover sacrifice at the place - the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name . . . Do this in the evening as the sun sets at the same time you departed from Egypt

verses.original: וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֙ וְאָ֣כַלְתָּ֔ בַּמָּק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּ֑וֹ וּפָנִ֣יתָ יִבְחַ֛ר בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ לְאֹהָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiš·šal·tā wə·’ā·ḵal·tā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bōw ū·p̄ā·nî·ṯā yiḇ·ḥar ḇab·bō·qer wə·hā·laḵ·tā lə·’ō·hā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: And you shall roast it and eat it in the place - the LORD your God - will choose and in the morning you shall return to your tents

verses.original: שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכַ֣ל מַצּ֑וֹת הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וּבַיּ֣וֹם עֲצֶ֙רֶת֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה מְלָאכָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm tō·ḵal maṣ·ṣō·wṯ haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ū·ḇay·yō·wm ‘ă·ṣe·reṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō ṯa·‘ă·śeh mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: For six days you must eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day you shall hold a solemn assembly to the LORD your God and you must not do any work

verses.original: תִּסְפָּר־ לָ֑ךְ שִׁבְעָ֥ה שָׁבֻעֹ֖ת לִסְפֹּ֔ר שִׁבְעָ֖ה שָׁבֻעֽוֹת׃ חֶרְמֵשׁ֙ מֵהָחֵ֤ל בַּקָּמָ֔ה תָּחֵ֣ל
verses.transliteration: tis·pār- lāḵ šiḇ·‘āh šā·ḇu·‘ōṯ lis·pōr šiḇ·‘āh šā·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ ḥer·mêš mê·hā·ḥêl baq·qā·māh tā·ḥêl
verses.literal: You are to count off seven weeks [from] . . . [the time] you first put the sickle . . . to the standing grain . . .

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חַ֤ג שָׁבֻעוֹת֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מִסַּ֛ת נִדְבַ֥ת יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ יְבָרֶכְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḥaḡ šā·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mis·saṯ niḏ·ḇaṯ yā·ḏə·ḵā ’ă·šer tit·tên ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā
verses.literal: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God . . . with a freewill offering . . . that you give in proportion to how the LORD your God has blessed you

verses.original: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֞ לִפְנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ יִבְחַר֙ לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבִתֶּךָ֮ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶךָ֒ וְהַלֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ וְהַגֵּ֛ר וְהַיָּת֥וֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·maḥ·tā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yiḇ·ḥar lə·šak·kên šə·mōw šām ’at·tāh ū·ḇin·ḵā ū·ḇit·te·ḵā wə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā wa·’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā wə·hal·lê·wî ’ă·šer biš·‘ā·re·ḵā wə·hag·gêr wə·hay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·hā·’al·mā·nāh ’ă·šer bə·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in the place - He . . . will choose as a dwelling for His Name . . . you your sons and daughters your menservants and maidservants and the Levite - within your gates as well as the foreigner the fatherless and the widows - among you

verses.original: וְזָ֣כַרְתָּ֔ כִּי־ הָיִ֖יתָ עֶ֥בֶד בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ וְעָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת־ הָאֵֽלֶּה׃פ הַֽחֻקִּ֖ים
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā kî- hā·yî·ṯā ‘e·ḇeḏ bə·miṣ·rā·yim wə·šā·mar·tā wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- hā·’êl·leh ha·ḥuq·qîm
verses.literal: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and carefully follow - these statutes

verses.original: תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ חַ֧ג הַסֻּכֹּ֛ת שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בְּאָ֨סְפְּךָ֔ מִֽגָּרְנְךָ֖ וּמִיִּקְבֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·śeh lə·ḵā ḥaḡ has·suk·kōṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm bə·’ā·sə·pə·ḵā mig·gā·rə·nə·ḵā ū·mî·yiq·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: You are to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered [the produce of] your threshing floor and your winepress

verses.original: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֖ בְּחַגֶּ֑ךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֤ וּבִתֶּ֙ךָ֙ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְהַלֵּוִ֗י וְהַגֵּ֛ר וְהַיָּת֥וֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·maḥ·tā bə·ḥag·ge·ḵā ’at·tāh ū·ḇin·ḵā ū·ḇit·te·ḵā wə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā wa·’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā wə·hal·lê·wî wə·hag·gêr wə·hay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·hā·’al·mā·nāh ’ă·šer biš·‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: And you shall rejoice in your feast you your sons and daughters your menservants and maidservants and the Levite as well as the foreigner the fatherless and the widows - among you

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תָּחֹג֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֑ה יִבְחַ֣ר כִּ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ יְבָרֶכְךָ֞ בְּכֹ֤ל תְּבוּאָֽתְךָ֙ וּבְכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔יךָ שָׂמֵֽחַ׃ וְהָיִ֖יתָ אַ֥ךְ
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tā·ḥōḡ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- Yah·weh yiḇ·ḥar kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā bə·ḵōl tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā śā·mê·aḥ wə·hā·yî·ṯā ’aḵ
verses.literal: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to the LORD your God in the place - He will choose because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands so that your joy will be complete

verses.original: שָׁל֣וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֣ים׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֡ה כָל־ זְכוּרְךָ֜ אֶת־ יֵרָאֶ֨ה פְּנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֔ר בְּחַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַשָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּבְחַ֣ג הַסֻּכּ֑וֹת וְלֹ֧א יֵרָאֶ֛ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lō·wōš pə·‘ā·mîm baš·šā·nāh ḵāl zə·ḵū·rə·ḵā ’eṯ- yê·rā·’eh pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥār bə·ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ḥaḡ haš·šā·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ḥaḡ has·suk·kō·wṯ wə·lō yê·rā·’eh ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh rê·qām
verses.literal: Three times a year all your men . . . are to appear before the LORD your God in the place - He will choose at the Feast of Unleavened Bread the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles No one should appear . . . before the LORD empty-handed

verses.original: אִ֖ישׁ כְּמַתְּנַ֣ת יָד֑וֹ כְּבִרְכַּ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־ לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’îš kə·mat·tə·naṯ yā·ḏōw kə·ḇir·kaṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer nā·ṯan- lāḵ
verses.literal: Everyone must appear with a gift as he is able according to the blessing the LORD your God - has given you

verses.original: תִּֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֙ שֹׁפְטִ֣ים וְשֹֽׁטְרִ֗ים לִשְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ וְשָׁפְט֥וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם צֶֽדֶק׃ מִשְׁפַּט־
verses.transliteration: tit·ten- lə·ḵā šō·p̄ə·ṭîm wə·šō·ṭə·rîm liš·ḇā·ṭe·ḵā bə·ḵāl šə·‘ā·re·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā wə·šā·p̄ə·ṭū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ṣe·ḏeq miš·paṭ-
verses.literal: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the LORD your God is giving you They are to judge - the people with righteous judgment

verses.original: לֹא־ תַטֶּ֣ה מִשְׁפָּ֔ט תַכִּ֖יר פָּנִ֑ים וְלֹא־ לֹ֥א תִקַּ֣ח שֹׁ֔חַד כִּ֣י הַשֹּׁ֗חַד יְעַוֵּר֙ עֵינֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֔ים וִֽיסַלֵּ֖ף דִּבְרֵ֥י צַדִּיקִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯaṭ·ṭeh miš·pāṭ ṯak·kîr pā·nîm wə·lō- lō ṯiq·qaḥ šō·ḥaḏ kî haš·šō·ḥaḏ yə·‘aw·wêr ‘ê·nê ḥă·ḵā·mîm wî·sal·lêp̄ diḇ·rê ṣad·dî·qim
verses.literal: Do not deny justice or show partiality . . . . . . Do not accept a bribe for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous

verses.original: תִּרְדֹּ֑ף צֶ֥דֶק צֶ֖דֶק לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיֶה֙ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: tir·dōp̄ ṣe·ḏeq ṣe·ḏeq lə·ma·‘an tiḥ·yeh wə·yā·raš·tā ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: Pursue justice and justice alone so that you may live and you may possess - the land that the LORD your God is giving you

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִטַּ֥ע לְךָ֛ כָּל־ עֵ֑ץ אֲשֵׁרָ֖ה אֵ֗צֶל מִזְבַּ֛ח תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃ס יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiṭ·ṭa‘ lə·ḵā kāl- ‘êṣ ’ă·šê·rāh ’ê·ṣel miz·baḥ ta·‘ă·śeh- lāḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer
verses.literal: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God -

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תָקִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מַצֵּבָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס שָׂנֵ֖א
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯā·qîm lə·ḵā maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā śā·nê
verses.literal: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar which the LORD your God hates
